issues.name: Automatic Logout and Session Loss

issues.name: Login and Authentication Failures

issues.name: Lyrics Display and Loading Issues

issues.name: Downloads locked to premium

issues.name: Slow or Non-Functional Offline Playback

issues.name: App Crashes and Playback Freezes

issues.name: Wrong Song Playing When Selected
